# GraphHopper

GraphHopper Directions API provides enterprise-grade routing services, including route planning, optimization, geocoding, and more, for various vehicle types.

Category: Developer. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/graphhopper/.

## Actions

- **GraphHopper Geocoding** (read-only): Perform forward or reverse geocoding.
- **POST Route**: Calculate complex routes via POST /route.
- **Calculate Matrix**: Calculate distance, time, or weight matrices via POST.
- **Capacity Clustering**: Solve capacity clustering problem.
- **Get Custom Profiles** (read-only): Retrieve a list of all user-defined routing profiles.
- **Get Isochrone** (read-only): Compute isochrone polygons for a given point.
- **GraphHopper VRP POST**: Initiate VRP optimization.
- **Upload GPX File**: Upload a GPX file to a public file hosting endpoint.
